verdict.rationale: Cake ships an MCP integration letting users connect Claude/Codex/Cursor and query cap table data (shareholders, vesting, option pool headroom) in plain English, which is genuine natural-language operation of part of the product. However, this is explicitly read-only ('All read-only'), so natural-language commands cannot perform actions like issuing shares, running raises, or editing vesting — core write operations remain UI-only. Missing for 10: natural-language support for write/action commands (issuances, approvals, raises), independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
